name: ДДС - Bulgarian value added tax on construction
standard: Закон за данък върху добавената стойност (ЗДДС), чл. 66
description: Reference document for ДДС. The standard rate is 20 % (ЗДДС чл. 66, ал. 1) and it is the rate construction works are charged at. The reduced rate of 9 % (чл. 66, ал. 2) covers hotel accommodation; the temporary 9 % on restaurant services and some foods ended on 1 January 2025. Exports and intra-EU supplies are zero-rated. The rates are on file in the platform's dated tax table (code DDS, 20 % the default since 1999-01-01) and the BG markup stack is a single ДДС line on the direct cost, because a КСС carries overheads and profit inside its unit rates. The pack prices every bill excluding ДДС and adds ДДС once, at the end. From 1 January 2026 the registration threshold is EUR 51 130 of taxable turnover in a calendar year. The bulgaria rule set checks that a bill carries one ДДС line, at 20 %, charged on all of "Общо без ДДС" and with nothing added after it; a bill with no ДДС line is a warning only, since a contractor below the threshold charges none.
review_status: Rates are taken from the НАП and from 2026 professional summaries, read on 2026-10-31. The tax treatment of a specific contract is a matter for the parties' tax advisers.
